actual: Cleanup-after-merge does not use the existing branch-to-worktree resolver when --worktree is omitted, Windows process-reference protection excludes only the current and parent PIDs, and finalizer aftercare repeats remote reads without bounded retry or snapshot reuse. Auto-discover and verify the exact registered worktree, exclude only the full caller ancestor chain, add bounded backoff for idempotent read operations, and reduce redundant remote reads while preserving manifest preflight, live rescan, deletion readback, and force-with-lease safety.
